name: distribution-god
description: Repo-native AI strategist: analyzes any repository like a master strategist and distribution expert — business strategy, market and competitor research, distribution plan, gap analysis, and moat roadmap, written to STRATEGY.md with calibrated verdicts, the path to the next band, and pivot options — finds real people who recently asked for what you built and drafts the replies you send (a private FIRST-CUSTOMERS.md), then researches trends, papers, and look-alike products for pragmatic, testable fixes to its weakest points.
